account: It is day 0, shortly after 09:00. I came to town hall to read my appointments. Today calls for office correspondence, a 10:00 plaza market walk, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with a neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I have asked the secretary about correspondence, news, and which cottage hosts tea; I do not yet have answers. The secretary said the appointments chest was empty, apparently while I had temporarily borrowed its book. I had already returned it, and then saw the secretary retrieve it. This looks like a timing misunderstanding, not evidence of anything suspicious. The builder has arrived near me holding a lantern. I asked what brings them here and whether town work needs discussing, but have not yet heard a reply, so their purpose remains unknown. Several townsfolk and a pupil have passed near the hall. I have noticed no confirmed unusual event or coordinated activity in town.
